title: Breach Metric0 High Value Outliers
dataSources: Breach alerts (`breach:alert`), inbox stats (`inbox:stats`), cloud-drive usage (`clouddrive:usage`), certificate expiry (`certexpiry:check`).
app: Personal cybersecurity feeds — Have-I-Been-Pwned breach alerts, personal email/inbox stats, cloud-storage usage APIs, and personal TLS-certificate expiry checks — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=breach:metric0 value=*
| eventstats perc90(value) as p90, perc10(value) as p10
| where value>=p90 OR value<=p10
| table _time source_id value p90 p10
description: Surfaces the highest and lowest value outliers in breach metric0 events.
value: Tail events often explain spikes in cost, effort, or risk that averages hide.
implementation: Compute percentile bands on `value` and review extreme breach metric0 records.
visualization: Scatter plot of value with percentile bands.
grandmaExplanation: It adds up the unusually high or low value moments in your breach metric0 history.
